about-page.title: A Zagreb grill and bistro for everyday meals
about-page.p-1: Dvije Žarulje is located at Ulica Brune Bušića 28 in Zagreb. The offer focuses on food people look for when they want a proper lunch: grill, daily dishes, fried classics, salads and sides.
about-page.p-2: The menu includes familiar favorites such as ćevapi, gourmet burgers, chicken grill, Wiener and Zagreb-style schnitzel, and daily cooked dishes.
about-page.p-3: The idea is simple: familiar flavors, honest portions and a meal you can enjoy in the restaurant, take away or order for delivery.

footer.p: Dvije Žarulje serves grill dishes, daily specials, fried classics, salads and sides in Zagreb.
